key_insight: SQuAT improves low-bit LLM vector quantization-aware training by separating direction and magnitude gradients, inducing tangent-space updates for weight directions.
engineering_relevance: Distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment reduces VQ-QAT training time by 12.8×, enabling training runs of up to 10 billion tokens.
method: Decompose weight vectors into normalized directions and gains.
Quantize directions with an E8-derived spherical codebook and gains with low-bit scalar quantizers, using separate straight-through estimators.
Assign disjoint weight blocks across workers and communicate only discrete quantization indices.
evidence_signal: Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B and Qwen3-4B, plus base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify inference latency, memory savings, or distributed hardware requirements, leaving deployment costs unclear.
paper_title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
